verdict.rationale: Calendly's signup flow explicitly advertises 'No credit card required' and community users confirm having used the free tier for real individual scheduling for extended periods, including basic one-off booking links. However, community evidence also shows real limitations on the free tier (e.g. only one event-type configuration, features later moved off free tier), so it's usable for basic individual scheduling but not full-featured. Missing for 10: first-party pricing-page breakdown explicitly listing free-tier scope/limits, and more recent independent confirmation the free tier still supports a usable booking link today.
